# tap-tap

> tap-tap is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that keeps a 3D animal
> character on your desktop. Tap your own character and every teammate on that
> team sees their character dance on their screen. There is no sign up: you join
> a team with a nickname and a six character invite code.

Written by GitHub user hayoung-99, built with Electron, MIT licensed. The name is
always written lowercase and hyphenated: tap-tap. It is unrelated to the TapTap
game store (taptap.io). The landing page is Korean and English; the app itself
runs in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese.

## Facts

- Price: free. No ads, no paid tier, no in-app purchases.
- Platforms: macOS on Apple Silicon and Intel (.dmg), Windows 64-bit (.exe installer).
- Account: none. No email, no password. A device identifier created at install
  time is the only identity.
- Joining a team: one person creates a team and receives a six character invite
  code made of letters and digits, with 0, O, 1 and I excluded. The code expires
  24 hours after it is issued and can be reissued at any time.
- Limits: one person can belong to up to 3 teams; each team holds up to 5 people.
  One character appears on your desktop per team.
- Characters: Happy Cat, Chubby Dog, Pudgy Panda, Dumb Duck, Hop Bunny.
- Interaction: clicks in the empty space around a character pass through to the
  desktop. Position and scale are remembered per team. It makes no sound, and the
  menu bar icon hides every character at once.
- What travels over the network: the fact that somebody tapped, plus a nickname.
  No screen contents and no files leave the machine. The Windows installer never
  asks for administrator rights.
- First launch: the app is not code signed, so macOS and Windows each show a
  warning box once. The landing page gives the exact steps for both, including
  System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway, which is what macOS 15 and
  later require.
- Updates: Windows downloads new versions quietly and swaps them in when you say
  so. macOS only announces that a new version exists.

## Pages

- [tap-tap (Korean)](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/): what it is, what opens
  after you install it, the five characters, downloads, first launch, FAQ.
- [tap-tap (English)](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/en/): the same page in English.
- [Downloads](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#download): macOS and Windows builds.
- [First launch](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#install): getting past the
  warning box on macOS and Windows.
- [FAQ](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#faq): what it is, whether teammates
  need it, whether it is free, using it alone, installing it on a work computer,
  and what to do if it will not open the first time.

## 한국어 요약

tap-tap 은 바탕화면에 3D 동물 캐릭터를 띄워 두는 macOS·Windows 무료 앱입니다.
내 캐릭터를 누르면 같은 팀 사람들의 화면에서 캐릭터가 춤을 춥니다. 가입하지 않고,
닉네임과 여섯 글자 초대코드로 팀에 들어갑니다. 초대코드는 영문과 숫자를 섞은 여섯
글자이고 24시간 뒤 만료됩니다. 한 사람이 최대 3개 팀, 팀 하나에 최대 5명이며
팀마다 캐릭터가 한 마리씩 뜹니다. 오가는 것은 누가 눌렀다는 신호와 이름뿐이고,
화면 내용이나 파일은 어디로도 가지 않습니다. 처음 열 때 확인 창이 한 번 뜨고,
넘기는 방법은 https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#install 에 있습니다.
